title: Cross-pair information diffusion at the daily clock: leave-one-out basket lead-lag
economic_mechanism: Currency pairs share a common G10 factor, and information that moves that factor - flow imbalance, macro reinterpretation, risk-premium shifts - is incorporated into related pairs with a measurable LAG rather than instantaneously: returns exhibit positive cross-autocorrelation and a lead-lag structure, with slow capital reallocation and investor inattention producing predictable next-period moves in the lagging assets (Lo & MacKinlay 1990: positive cross-autocorrelations across securities, not own-asset overreaction; Hou 2007: slow diffusion of information across related assets is a leading cause of the lead-lag effect). The proposed mechanism trades exactly the diffusion channel at the daily decision clock: for each pair i, the leave-one-out mean of the OTHER six pairs' most recent completed daily returns is the common-factor lead, and pair i is held in the lead's direction for one frozen multi-day horizon. The tradeable object is the CROSS-pair lag structure - not the pair's own past return (time-series momentum), not a same-period dispersion spread, and not any price-structure break.
causal_prediction: A pair's next multi-day move is positively predicted by the leave-one-out mean of the other six pairs' just-completed daily return, with positive after-cost expectancy at 1.5 bps/side. Falsifiable consequences frozen ex ante: (i) the anchor passes the inherited Stage-A gates; (ii) the placebo-schedule benchmark (identical law, lead read with a two-decision lag - stale diffusion information) does NOT match the anchor: incremental alpha > 0 is required, so the FRESH one-day diffusion, not generic drift, must carry the value; (iii) the self-lag causal control (identical law, direction from the pair's OWN previous-day return) must NOT reproduce the edge under the preregistered rule - if the pair's own past return predicts as well as the cross-pair lead, the cross-pair diffusion ingredient is not operative and the family fails regardless of the anchor's sign. Disclosed risk accepted ex ante: the daily-grain cadence is cost-heavy (3 bps round trip at base); if the gross diffusion edge is below break-even the family dies to costs, and break-even bps will attribute the reject.

primary_literature_trace.authors: Andrew W. Lo, A. Craig MacKinlay
primary_literature_trace.venue: When Are Contrarian Profits Due to Stock Market Overreaction?, Review of Financial Studies 3(2), 175-205
primary_literature_trace.claim: Security returns exhibit significantly positive cross-autocorrelations: returns of large stocks lead returns of smaller stocks, and this cross-lead structure alone can generate predictable profits, distinct from own-asset overreaction.

primary_literature_trace.venue: Industry Information Diffusion and the Lead-Lag Effect in Stock Returns, Review of Financial Studies 20(4), 1113-1138
primary_literature_trace.claim: Slow diffusion of information across related assets is a leading cause of the lead-lag effect: returns on informed assets predict subsequent returns on lagging related assets, consistent with gradual information flow rather than pure time-varying risk.

primary_literature_trace.authors: Harrison Hong, Walter Torous, Ivo Valkanov
primary_literature_trace.venue: Do Industries Lead the Stock Market? Gradual Diffusion of Information and Cross-Asset Return Predictability
primary_literature_trace.claim: Cross-asset return predictability arises from gradual information diffusion: industry returns predict aggregate market returns with a lag.
primary_literature_trace.metadata_status: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: title confirmed verbatim in the related-literature listing of the Hou (2007) search result; venue/year recalled as Journal of Financial Economics 2007 and NOT independently re-verified (search rate-limited). Supporting citation only.
primary_literature_trace.fx_transfer_note: Both verified papers are equity-market results. The transfer of cross-asset lead-lag diffusion to daily-grain G10 FX pairs is the hypothesis under test and is flagged UNVERIFIED_TRANSFER, honestly.

pit_observables.note: Scored input is the authorized Twelve-Data-derived H1 research series only (7 pairs, completed-bar PIT, snapshot 2020-01-30..2026-09-02). No D1 data, no bid/ask, no macro series, no calendar events. All observables are exact OHLC-derived.
pit_observables.decision_instant_T: The completion instant of the daily 16:00 America/New_York flat bar (20:00Z EDT / 21:00Z EST via zoneinfo, never fixed offsets). One decision per pair per NY trading day; session entry gate inherited (Sun 21:00 -> Fri 16:00 NY; first weekly decision is Monday's 16:00-NY bar).
pit_observables.daily_close_P_i_T: Close of pair i's 16:00-NY flat bar at decision T. All 7 pairs' closes must exist; any missing bar => the affected pair-day is NO_EVAL (fail-closed), never fill-forward.
pit_observables.daily_return_r_i_T: ln(P_i(T) / P_i(T_prev)) between consecutive completed 16:00-NY closes (weekend gap = one return over Friday->Monday).
pit_observables.lead_i_T: Mean of r_j(T) over the 6 pairs j != i (leave-one-out: the pair's own return is excluded so the self ingredient lives only in the control arm).
pit_observables.direction_i_T: sign(lead_i(T)); +1 = long pair i / short USD-side per quote convention; exact zero => NO_EVAL (measure-zero).
pit_observables.warmup: One completed prior NY-day per pair (warmup_bars: 50 H1 bars with buffer); first decisions occur in the first full week of the snapshot.
pit_observables.fail_closed: Any missing bar in the 7-pair decision set, the lead computation, the entry bar or the exit bar => NO_EVAL / voided signal / earliest-scheduled exit only.

universe_warmup_clock_fills.pair_universe_justification: Frozen 7-pair V3 universe, all pairs: the mechanism is inherently cross-sectional over the whole set, and leave-one-out symmetry gives every pair the identical follower role. Ex-ante subsetting is forbidden and would break the leave-one-out construction; heterogeneity is handled ex post by concentration gates and drop-one.
universe_warmup_clock_fills.decision_clock: Daily: one decision per pair per NY trading day at the completed 16:00-NY flat bar (daily-or-slower rule satisfied; no intraday decision anywhere).
universe_warmup_clock_fills.entry_fills: Next-session fill: the open of the next 16:00-NY bar after the decision bar completes (one-event lag; no same-bar fills).
universe_warmup_clock_fills.holding_and_exit: Anchor holds exactly 5 daily periods: exit at the open of the 16:00-NY bar 5 NY-trading-days after the entry day (Fri entry exits at the next Friday's 16:00-NY bar; weekends collapse into one return). No profit target, no time stop other than the frozen horizon; one position per pair; while holding, decisions are evaluated but no re-entry occurs. Force-flat at fold boundaries (inherited).
universe_warmup_clock_fills.missing_bar_rule: Fail-closed NO_TRADE / earliest-scheduled exit; never silent fill-forward.

anchor.spec: At each decision T: if flat, enter direction_i = sign(leave-one-out 6-pair mean daily return) at the next 16:00-NY bar open; hold 5 daily periods; exit at the frozen horizon; no re-entry while holding.

single_frozen_parameter_set.lead_definition: leave-one-out mean of the other 6 pairs' last completed daily log returns

neighbour.one_presumption_away: Replaces only the diffusion-horizon presumption (5 daily periods) with a shorter 2-day horizon, holding the lead construction, clocks, fills, costs and governor identical. If diffusion is real, the neighbour moves TOGETHER with the anchor (same verdict sign, similar fold pattern); divergence means the horizon presumption is knife-edge and the family is not promotable.

control.role: Causal negative control: destroys exactly the CROSS-pair ingredient (the diffusion lead) while holding the daily clock, holding law, costs and governor identical. Direction is taken from the pair's OWN previous completed daily return (lag-1 self signal) instead of the other six pairs' mean.
control.spec: Identical to anchor EXCEPT direction_i := sign(r_i(T)) (own lag-1 daily return). All else byte-identical.
control.preregistered_non_reproduction_rule: The control REPRODUCES (and the family FAILS its control gate regardless of anchor sign) if control expectancy > 0 AND control PF >= 1.10 (inherited control_reject_pf), OR control expectancy >= 0.5 x anchor expectancy. A firing self-lag control means the anchor is generic short-horizon time-series momentum, not cross-pair diffusion; positive raw control PnL never overrides a firing control.

incremental_test_vs_frozen_benchmark.benchmark_definition: Per baseline_invariants.json v3_benchmark_treatment, macro-free case: the SAME mechanism under the PLACEBO CONTROL SCHEDULE, at identical decision clock, fills, universe, warmup and costs. Concretely: the anchor law with the leave-one-out lead read at T-2 NY-days (two-decision-stale lead). The schedule shape, event count, cadence and costs are structurally identical; the fresh one-day diffusion information is destroyed.
incremental_test_vs_frozen_benchmark.why_distinct_from_the_control: The placebo benchmark keeps the CROSS-pair construction but destroys its freshness (tests WHEN the information is used); the causal control keeps freshness but swaps cross-pair for self (tests WHETHER the cross-pair ingredient matters). Both must behave as preregistered for the family to stand.
incremental_test_vs_frozen_benchmark.gate: overall incremental alpha > 0: anchor expectancy minus placebo-benchmark expectancy. Positive raw anchor PnL never overrides a failed incremental alpha. The benchmark schedule is an auxiliary treatment inside the anchor cell, not a fourth scored arm.

dual_book_and_financing.mandate: Mandatory dual book per baseline_invariants.json v3_dual_book: every scored cell books BOTH price_only_pnl_usd and financing_adjusted_pnl_usd as separate immutable digest-covered columns, all arms - even though this proposal is macro-free and its direction never reads a rate.
dual_book_and_financing.financing_formula_frozen_verbatim: financing_adjusted_pnl = price_only_pnl + sign * notional_usd * (r_base - r_quote) * holding_days/365, accrued per calendar day at the day-start as-of differential; sign=+1 for long base/short quote, -1 for short base/long quote
dual_book_and_financing.asof_accrual_semantics: Each calendar day's accrual reads adopted BIS WS_CBPOL vintages gated on available_time_utc <= that day's 16:00-NY decision instant (never effective-date-alone). The macro series enters ONLY the financing column, never the direction.
dual_book_and_financing.disclosed_approximation: Policy rates are unsecured official rates, NOT swap/OIS-implied rollover; disclosed ex ante per PLAN_forex_v3.md section 2. No financing precision beyond policy-rate differentials is assumed.
dual_book_and_financing.financing_gate: The price-only book must not invert the sign of the anchor's expectancy (the financing term must not manufacture the edge). For this price-only-mechanism family the price-only book is the primary object and the financing book is the mandated co-reported treatment.

cost.f1_fixed_application: F1-FIXED per baseline_invariants.json v3_cost_schedule: tier multipliers applied to BOOKED stress PnL via the P1 kernel (research/assets/forex_free_v3/accounting.py book_stress); base / tier-1.5 / tier-2.0 rows pairwise distinct when trades non-empty.
cost.delay_stress: Frozen one-event delay (entry and exit shifted one additional 16:00-NY bar) as a SEPARATE stress component, never blended into cost tiers (lesson V3-L2).
cost.break_even_diagnostic: break_even_bps_per_side = mean gross per-trade return (bps of the 10000 USD unit, both books) / 2, full-sample and per fold, anchor arm. Frozen interpretation: the 5-day horizon needs ~3 bps gross per round trip (~0.6 bps/day) to clear base cost; if break-even bps < tier bps the cell is structurally unprofitable at that tier. Diagnostic, never a fee rescue.

governor.enforcement: Deterministic and PIT-safe; blocked signals are NO_TRADE, never deferred. Holding implies no new entry until exit.

expected_turnover.decisions_per_pair_estimate: ~1,600 NY-day decisions per pair (~11,000 aggregate); >= 40 decisions per arm satisfied by two orders of magnitude.
expected_turnover.analytic_schedule_argument: Position cycle: entry the NY-day after a decision, 5-period hold, immediate re-entry at the next post-exit decision => ~1 round trip per ~6 NY trading days => ~40 RT/pair-year over ~250 NY-days. Band accounts for holidays, NO_EVAL days and purge windows.
expected_turnover.full_sample_schedule_estimate: ~250-290 RT per pair; ~1,750-2,000 across 7 pairs (schedule estimate only; no data loaded).

sample_floors.populated_rule: fold populated iff >= 30 trades (inherited fold_populated_min_trades); a cell below floors is INDETERMINATE, not negative evidence

expected_turnover.turnover_feasibility_note: Disclosed ex ante: at ~1,900 round trips the family pays ~5,700 bps aggregate base cost and needs a gross diffusion edge above ~3 bps per 5-day trade (~0.6 bps/day). Documented cross-autocorrelation edges at this horizon are small, so cost-dominance is a live possibility; A9-F's break-even headroom check and the mandatory break-even bps reporting decide honestly.

folds_plan.scheme: 3 chronological folds over the decision span: F1 2020-03-01..2022-05-01, F2 2022-05-01..2024-07-01, F3 2024-07-01..2026-09-02 (UTC dates; warmup excluded). Purge 14 calendar days either side of internal boundaries (2022-04-17..2022-05-15, 2024-06-17..2024-07-15): trades whose entry OR exit instant falls inside a purge window are excluded from that fold's statistics and counted in purge_excluded. Stage-A requires >= 2/3 populated folds positive.
folds_plan.stage_a_note: All inherited V2 frozen gates apply unchanged (min_expectancy_gt 0, min_pf 1.1, mdd ceiling 2500 USD, max_positive_fold_share 0.5, max_pair_positive_share 0.4, stress_min_pf 1.0, dropout_survival_min_of_7 5, usd_corr_abs_ceiling 0.3, usd_diag_min_days 60).

concentration_plan.pair_concentration_gate: No single pair > 40% of gross positive trade PnL full-sample; no single pair > 50% within any populated fold (inherited ceilings). Leave-one-out symmetry makes any breach a data artifact or unintended pair-specific mechanism.
concentration_plan.direction_check: Long and short trades must each be >= 25% of anchor trades full-sample (design-coherence check inherited from V2 concentration practice).
concentration_plan.usd_drift_disclosure: The leave-one-out lead is a common-factor signal: follower directions are frequently same-signed, so the book can load on the USD factor. The inherited USD-drift diagnostic applies unchanged (|corr(daily PnL, USD-wide move)| <= 0.3 over >= 60 days): if the diffusion edge is actually USD-wide drift, the diagnostic FAILS the family and the reject stands. This is disclosed ex ante and is not tuned around.

drop_one_pair_plan.procedure: Recompute the full anchor schedule (and neighbour/control/bench identically) 7 times, each excluding exactly one pair; the leave-one-out lead of the remaining pairs is recomputed on the reduced 6-pair set.
drop_one_pair_plan.gate: Anchor expectancy stays positive and PF >= 1.00 in at least 5 of 7 drop-one recomputes (inherited dropout_survival_min_of_7).
drop_one_pair_plan.interpretation: Failure means the diffusion edge is carried by one pair's idiosyncratic episode, not a cross-pair structure. Drop-one is non-vacuous by construction (dropping a pair changes both the traded set and every lead).

minimum_decisions.definition: A decision = one pair-NY-day on which the arm's frozen schedule completed a lead evaluation (go or no-go). NO_EVAL days count as decisions without trades.

failure_interpretation: Negative anchor expectancy after base cost: one-day cross-pair diffusion has no after-cost edge at the frozen cost authority at this cadence - a complete, publishable reject with break-even bps attributing cost-dominance vs absence of gross edge; no sign inversion, no threshold/horizon rescue, no pair subset, no lower cost. Anchor positive but control fires under the preregistered rule: the pair's own past return predicts as well as the cross-pair lead, the edge is generic short-horizon time-series momentum, and the cross-pair diffusion claim is falsified. Anchor positive but incremental alpha <= 0 vs the two-decision-stale placebo: the edge is schedule drift, not fresh diffusion information; not promotable. Neighbour diverges from anchor: the horizon presumption is knife-edge; not promotable. USD-drift diagnostic flags the book: the edge is the USD common factor itself, not diffusion between pairs; reject. Drop-one or concentration failure: single-pair artifact; reject. Realised turnover outside the preregistered band: INELIGIBLE per the frequency contract.

no_parameter_grid_note: Exactly one frozen value per constant per arm (leave-one-out lead, horizons 5/2 days, lag-2 placebo). No grids, menus or tuning anywhere; the neighbour is a distinct single frozen spec, not a second point on the anchor's knob.

novelty_self_check.vs_V1_family1_london_open_momentum_conti: No session-open price, no session label, no intraday clock anywhere: the only clock is the frozen daily 16:00-NY decision bar, and direction comes from the other pairs' completed daily returns, never from a session-structure measurement.
novelty_self_check.vs_V1_family2_late_NY_standardized_exten: No fade and no standardized-extension observable exist; the anchor CONTINUES a cross-pair common-factor move at a one-day lag; no late-session window is used in state, trigger, entry or exit.
novelty_self_check.vs_V2_family1_tokyo_compression_london_e: No session range, no compression state, no expansion/breach trigger; the mechanism needs no range or channel at all - only completed daily closes across pairs.
novelty_self_check.vs_V2_family2_london_AM_break_retest_hol: No range break and no retest-hold confirmation anywhere; entry is a cross-sectional mean-sign rule at the daily bar, structurally unrelated to intraday range mechanics.
novelty_self_check.re_clock_check: This is not a re-clock of any forbidden row: none of the four rows is a cross-pair lead-lag construction, so no daily-grain relabeling of them occurs; the mechanism (leave-one-out common-factor diffusion) is new relative to the inventory.
novelty_self_check.blanket_clauses: No sign inversion of a rejected family; no reduced costs; no pair cherry-picking (leave-one-out over all 7 pairs); no result-aware reuse of V1/V2 packets (fresh blind packet, new hypothesis_id, independent design).
novelty_self_check.vs_V2_sibling_mechanisms_honest_extra: vs FXFV2-A5-P1/P2 (same-day cross-sectional dispersion RV: extreme-vs-extreme and outlier-basket reversal within a session): this proposal is NEXT-period CONTINUATION of a leave-one-out common-factor mean across NY-days - different grain (daily vs intraday session), different direction (continuation vs dispersion convergence), different construction (mean sign vs spread baskets). vs FXFV2-A6-P1 (H1 compression-gated 48-bar channel breach): no channel, no compression gate, no intraday bar. vs FXFV2-A6-P2 (session liquidity seasonal): no session-hour observable of any kind. Honest adjacency note: a firing self-lag control would mean the edge is time-series momentum, which is exactly what the preregistered control rule is built to catch and reject.
